tools.name: DomainTools
tools.desc: Comprehensive domain search and research tools
pros: Ready to use out of the box, no local install or maintenance
Free tier available, try before you upgrade
cons: Advanced features and higher limits usually require a paid plan
usage:
Step: Open the official site and sign up
Click the red "Visit official site" button to open the DomainTools homepage. Find "Sign Up" and log in with email or Google/GitHub.
Tip:
If the site won’t load, check your connection or try another browser.

Step: Pick the plan that fits you
New users usually get a free trial or free quota. Start with the Free tier before upgrading.
Check:
After sign-up you should see the Dashboard home.

Step: Create your first task / project
Click "New" or "Create New" and follow the guide. Pick the first template to start.
Tip:
Don’t start with a complex request. Test with one simple sentence, e.g. "Summarize this page into 3 points".

Step: Review and save the result
When done, the tool shows the result. Export, copy the link, or save locally.
Check:
If unhappy, click "Regenerate" or tweak the prompt and try again.
tools.detail: DomainTools is a comprehensive domain search and research platform designed for developers, digital marketers, and domain investors. The tool provides an extensive database of domain names, offering detailed information on domain ownership, registration history, and domain availability. Key features include domain availability checks, domain backlink analysis, domain name suggestions, and comprehensive domain WHOIS data. It is particularly useful for those looking to identify potential competitors, monitor domain trends, and conduct thorough due diligence before purchasing a domain. DomainTools is ideal for professionals in the domain industry, SEO specialists, and web developers. Pros: Extensive domain database, detailed domain information, user-friendly interface. Limitations: Some features may require a subscription, and the user interface can be overwhelming for new users.

It enables users to find and track potential domain names that match their criteria, helping them stay ahead of the market. The tool offers a variety of search filters, including keyword matching, domain extension, and domain age. Domain Hunter Pro also includes a monitoring feature that alerts users when a domain becomes available for registration. Key features include a domain suggestion engine, domain availability checker, and a comprehensive database of domain names. It is particularly useful for those who are actively looking to acquire new domain names for their projects or investments. While Domain Hunter Pro is highly effective for domain hunting, it can be overwhelming for users who are not familiar with domain investing.
